{{Current events|year=2018|month=04|day=2|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Land Day incidents]]
**[[Saudi Arabia|Saudi]] [[King of Saudi Arabia|King]] [[Salman of Saudi Arabia|Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud]] and [[United States]] [[President of the United States|President]] [[Donald Trump]] hold a telephone conversation discussing the incidents. [http://www.business-standard.com/article/news-ians/saudi-king-trump-discuss-mideast-peace-process-over-phone-118040300603_1.html (''Business Standard'')]
;Disasters and accidents
*[[Earthquakes in 2018]]
**A [[Moment magnitude scale|magnitude]] 6.8 [[earthquake]] strikes near [[Tarija]], [[Bolivia]], and is felt as far as [[São Paulo]], [[Brazil]], approximately {{convert|3,000|km|mi}} away. There are no reports of major damage or casualties. [http://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/magnitude-68-earthquake-strikes-bolivia-54176069 (ABC)]
*A [[lorry]] carrying five circus elephants crashes in [[Albacete]], [[Spain]], killing one elephant. [http://www.foxnews.com/world/2018/04/02/truck-carrying-elephants-crashes-in-spain-at-least-one-animal-killed.html (Fox News)]
*An oxygen cylinder explodes at a [[Burger King]] restaurant in [[Yerevan]], [[Armenia]], resulting in at least nine injuries. [http://www.armradio.am/en/2018/04/02/explosion-in-downtown-yerevan-nine-injured/ (Public Radio of Armenia)]
*A light aircraft and a small jet collide on a runway at [[Marion Municipal Airport]], [[Indiana]], [[United States]]. Two are killed and five more survive. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/04/03/us/indiana-firefighters-plane-collision/index.html (CNN)]

;International relations
*[[China–United States relations]]
**The [[White House]] criticizes [[China]]'s decision to place [[tariff]]s of up to 25% on 128 [[United States|U.S.]] imports including pork and wine which was in retaliation to [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s decision to introduce [[Trump tariffs|tariffs]] on Chinese steel and aluminium imports. [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-43622862 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Philippine presidential election, 2016]]
**The [[Philippine presidential election, 2016#Electoral protest|manual recount]] of the votes begin for the 2016 vice presidential candidates, former [[Senate of the Philippines|Senator]] [[Bongbong Marcos]] and incumbent [[Vice President of the Philippines|Vice President]] [[Leni Robredo]]. [http://cnnphilippines.com/news/2018/04/02/Robredo-Marcos-vice-president-vote-recount-PET.html (CNN)]
*[[Caste politics]] in India
** ​Nine people have died amid [[April 2018 caste protests in India|violent protests]] involving tens of thousands of protesters from the [[Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes|SC/ST caste groups]] across India.[https://www.news18.com/news/india/bharat-bandh-live-will-bring-modi-govt-to-its-knees-says-mayawati-as-five-die-in-violent-protests-1705153.html (News18)]
*[[Terrorism in Egypt]]
**The [[Egypt]]ian [[Parliament of Egypt|Parliament]] approves a draft law creating the 18-member Supreme Council for ‎Combating Terrorism and Extremism. The new body is headed by the [[President of Egypt|President]] and is expected to also contain the [[Prime Minister of Egypt|Prime Minister]], the speaker of the House of Representatives, and the defence and interior ministers. The new body replaces the National Council to Combat Terrorism and Extremism created by Presidential decree by [[Abdel Fattah el-Sisi]] in 2017. [https://aawsat.com/english/home/article/1225806/egypt-parliament-approves-forming-supreme-council-countering-terrorism (Asharq Al-awsat)] [http://www.arabnews.com/node/1278451/middle-east (Arab News)]
*[[Egyptian presidential election, 2018]]
**Incumbent [[Abdel Fattah el-Sisi]] is declared the winner, with 97% of the vote and a 41% turnout.[http://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/64/294901/Egypt/Politics-/AbdelFattah-ElSisi-wins-second-year-term-as-Egypts.aspx (Ahram Online)]

;Science and technology
*[[Chinese space program]]
**[[China|Chinese]] space station ''[[Tiangong-1]]'' crashes into the South [[Pacific Ocean]] near [[Tahiti]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/04/01/asia/tiangong-1-china-space-lab-falls-intl/index.html (CNN)] [http://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-43614408 (BBC)]
* Astronomers report the discovery of [[MACS J1149 Lensed Star 1]], nicknamed Icarus, the farthest known star at 9 billion light-years away. [https://www.space.com/40171-cosmic-alignment-reveals-most-distant-star-yet.html (Space)]

;Sports
*[[2018 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament]]
**[[2017–18 Villanova Wildcats men's basketball team|Villanova]] beats [[2017–18 Michigan Wolverines men's basketball team|Michigan]] [[2018 NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship Game|79–62]] to win the [[NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Tournament|NCAA men's basketball championship]]. [https://www.marketwatch.com/story/villanova-rolls-past-michigan-to-win-second-ncaa-tournament-in-three-years-2018-04-02 (''Market Watch'')]
